## The fix:
The `human()` function was missing a case for durations less than 60 seconds. It was returning `unit(seconds // 60, "minute")` for all sub-hour durations, which resulted in `0 minutes` for anything under 60 seconds. I added an `elif seconds >= 60:` condition and an `else:` clause to return the raw seconds value when duration is less than 60 seconds.
